name: aquiles-platform
description: Aquiles - market intelligence and quantitative analytics platform

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:python && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test:coverage:funds-flow: uv run --project backend --no-sync pytest backend/tests/test_funds_flow_domain.py backend/tests/test_funds_flow_application.py backend/tests/test_funds_flow_sources.py backend/tests/test_funds_flow_source_adapters.py backend/tests/test_funds_flow_external_contracts.py backend/tests/test_financial_math_properties.py backend/tests/test_market_data_api_contracts.py backend/tests/test_domain_boundaries.py --cov=app.domains.funds_flow --cov=app.services.funds_flow_local_service --cov=app.services.funds_flow_analytics --cov=app.services.funds_flow_cftc --cov=app.services.funds_flow_utils --cov=app.services.funds_flow_insights --cov=app.utils.funds_flow_source_values --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=60
scripts.test:coverage:pure-finance: uv run --project backend --no-sync pytest backend/tests/test_cvm_cda_domain.py backend/tests/test_funds_flow_domain.py backend/tests/test_financial_math_properties.py backend/tests/test_fair_value_legs_pipeline.py backend/tests/test_fair_value_markov_pipeline.py backend/tests/test_macro_participant_models.py --cov=app.domains.funds_flow.domain.rules --cov=app.domains.market_data.domain.cvm_cda --cov=app.services.fair_value_legs_math --cov=app.services.fair_value_markov_math --cov=app.services.macro_participant_math --cov=app.utils.funds_flow_source_values --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project backend --no-sync ruff check backend/app backend/tests backend/run.py backend/run_*_service.py scripts/quality_budget.py
scripts.format:python: uv run --project backend --no-sync ruff format backend/app backend/tests backend/run.py backend/run_*_service.py
scripts.check: npm run quality:budget && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
